name: Roll-Over
description: Lying on your back, lift your straight legs and roll them over your head toward the floor behind you, then roll down slowly with control.

source.title: Online Pilates Classes: Joseph Pilates' 34 mat exercises

setup: Lie on your back, arms long by your sides, palms down.
cues: Press your arms into the mat.
Keep the weight off your neck.

prescription.note: Move with control and breathe steadily; quality before quantity.

keyframes.name: Legs up
keyframes.cue: Lying down, lift your legs straight up.

keyframes.name: Roll over
keyframes.cue: Roll your legs over your head, toes toward the floor.

keyframes.name: Roll down
keyframes.cue: Roll down one vertebra at a time, legs lowering.
